items.title: 2024 年度產品目錄更新
items.excerpt: 我們很高興地宣布 2024 年度產品目錄已經更新，新增多款環保材質板材，滿足您的各種設計需求。
items.content:
我們很高興地宣布 2024 年度產品目錄已經更新，新增多款環保材質板材，滿足您的各種設計需求。

本次更新包含以下亮點：

• 新增 20 款環保木紋系列
• 全新抗菌表面處理技術
• 更多色彩選擇滿足不同設計風格
• 改良的耐磨性能

我們持續致力於為客戶提供最優質的板材產品，歡迎下載最新目錄或聯繫我們的業務團隊了解更多詳情。

items.title: 榮獲 FSC 森林認證
items.excerpt: Hauboard 正式獲得 FSC 森林管理委員會認證，證明我們對永續發展的承諾。
items.content:
Hauboard 正式獲得 FSC 森林管理委員會認證，證明我們對永續發展的承諾。

FSC（Forest Stewardship Council）森林管理委員會是一個國際性的非營利組織，致力於推動負責任的森林管理。

獲得此認證代表：

• 我們的原材料來源可追溯且合法
• 生產過程符合環境保護標準
• 支持永續森林經營
• 產品可獲得 FSC 標籤

我們將繼續堅持環保理念，為地球的永續發展貢獻心力。

items.content:

items.title: 環保生產線升級完成
items.excerpt: 我們的生產線已完成環保升級，減少 30% 碳排放，為地球盡一份心力。
items.content:
我們的生產線已完成環保升級，減少 30% 碳排放，為地球盡一份心力。

升級內容包括：

• 引進節能設備，降低能源消耗
• 優化生產流程，減少原料浪費
• 安裝廢氣處理系統
• 實施水資源回收再利用

環保成效：

• 碳排放減少 30%
• 能源消耗降低 25%
• 廢料回收率提升至 95%
• 水資源使用效率提升 40%

我們將持續投入環保設施的升級，為永續發展貢獻更多心力。

items.title: 2024 Product Catalog Update
items.excerpt: We are pleased to announce that our 2024 product catalog has been updated with new eco-friendly materials to meet your various design needs.
items.content:
We are pleased to announce that our 2024 product catalog has been updated with new eco-friendly materials to meet your various design needs.

This update includes the following highlights:

• 20 new eco-friendly woodgrain series
• New antibacterial surface treatment technology
• More color options to meet different design styles
• Improved wear resistance

We are committed to providing our customers with the highest quality board products. Feel free to download the latest catalog or contact our sales team for more details.

items.title: FSC Certification Achieved
items.excerpt: Hauboard has officially received FSC Forest Stewardship Council certification, demonstrating our commitment to sustainability.
items.content:
Hauboard has officially received FSC Forest Stewardship Council certification, demonstrating our commitment to sustainability.

FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) is an international non-profit organization dedicated to promoting responsible forest management.

This certification represents:

• Our raw materials are traceable and legally sourced
• Production processes meet environmental protection standards
• Support for sustainable forest management
• Products can obtain FSC labels

We will continue to adhere to environmental principles and contribute to the sustainable development of our planet.

items.title: New Woodgrain Series Launch
items.excerpt: Our new woodgrain series is now available, offering more natural and refined texture options.
items.content:

Feel free to request samples or contact our sales team for more information.

items.title: Eco-friendly Production Line Upgrade Complete
items.excerpt: Our production line has completed an eco-friendly upgrade, reducing carbon emissions by 30%.
items.content:
Our production line has completed an eco-friendly upgrade, reducing carbon emissions by 30%.

Upgrade Contents:

• Introduced energy-saving equipment to reduce energy consumption
• Optimized production processes to reduce material waste
• Installed exhaust gas treatment systems
• Implemented water resource recycling

Environmental Results:

• 30% reduction in carbon emissions
• 25% reduction in energy consumption
• Waste recycling rate increased to 95%
• 40% improvement in water resource efficiency

We will continue to invest in environmental facility upgrades and contribute more to sustainable development.
